heading.title: Relations between the Union and the States

article.title: Power of Parliament to provide for the establishment of certain additional courts
article.content:
247Power of Parliament to provide for the establishment of certain additional courts

Article 247 · Part XI · Distribution of Legislative Powers
Notwithstanding anything in this Chapter, Parliament may by law provide for the establishment of any additional courts for the better administration of laws made by Parliament or of any existing laws with respect to a matter enumerated in the Union List.
